authorization_context.research_owner_instruction: Begin P2, route normative decisions to the human, and autonomously advance the remainder.

decisions.title: Label scope for P2 Shadow endpoints

A.summary: Use the P1 layered Reliability Matrix.

B.summary: Promote Outcome to a primary endpoint despite P1 shared semantic error.
B.risk: High repeatability may be mistaken for construct correctness.

C.summary: Use only ACCEPT/DO_NOT_ACCEPT as the primary endpoint.
C.risk: Most conservative, but loses process and scope diagnostics.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A preserves the final P1 Reliability Matrix without overstating unstable layers.

decisions.title: Runtime trace retention and privacy policy

A.summary: Foundation and first pilot use synthetic or explicitly public tasks only.
A.raw_retention: 30 days in access-controlled local research storage
A.derived_retention: Redacted hashes, metrics, and non-sensitive reports may be retained
A.incident_rule: Stop ingestion and quarantine the record if prohibited data appears

B.summary: Permit private operational traces with encryption and 90-day retention.
B.risk: Requires a named Data Steward and stronger access/erasure controls.

C.risk: Not recommended because it maximizes privacy and governance exposure.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A is sufficient to establish measurement and replay feasibility with minimal data risk.

decisions.title: Deterministic checks that retain hard-gate status

A.summary: Only exact checks mapped to an already approved P0 hard-gate rule may be hard.

B.summary: Treat every implemented deterministic check as a hard gate.
B.risk: Would silently promote P1 exploratory rules into non-compensatory gates.

C.summary: Keep all checks descriptive throughout P2.
C.risk: Safest but does not test a hard-gate Shadow policy.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A preserves P0 provenance and prevents the implementation from defining new normative gates.

decisions.title: Semantic Audit Agent configuration

A.summary: P2.0-P2.2 are deterministic-only; open a later exact-model gate before P2.3.
A.current_effect: No model calls, web, shell, or semantic judge in the foundation
later_requirements: no Human labels, Author Intent, Gold, hidden, or sealed data

B.summary: Enable a separate read-only semantic model during the first Shadow pilot.
B.risk: Adds cost, leakage surface, and judge variability before replay is established.

C.summary: Use the same model instance/family as Worker and Auditor.
C.risk: Increases correlated error and weakens independence.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A lets the project validate observability and replay before adding an LLM judge.

decisions.title: Offline reference-evaluator isolation

A.summary: Reference labels are produced on copied snapshots in a separate offline lane.
controls: freeze Shadow outputs before opening references
encrypt or custody reference material separately
never return reference details to Worker or Shadow Auditor

B.summary: Reveal reference labels to the Shadow Auditor after every case.
B.risk: Creates adaptive leakage and invalidates unbiased comparison.

C.summary: Expose the reference evaluator to the live Worker/Harness.
C.risk: Prohibited because it changes the task and may leak hidden evaluation.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A continues the project's separation of execution, auditing, and reference evaluation.

decisions.title: Initial Shadow sample and resource budget

A.summary: Use a staged budget rather than immediately running natural trajectories.
A.p2_3: Separate gate, maximum 20 semantic-auditor Candidate Stops
A.p2_4: Separate protocol freeze for exact Worker model, Harness commit, tasks, repeats, tokens, time, and cost

B.risk: Premature before event compatibility, privacy, and replay are verified.

C.summary: Use an open-ended sample and budget.
C.risk: Not reproducible and vulnerable to stopping-rule bias.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A preserves progress while deferring expensive or privacy-relevant runs until the infrastructure is verified.

decisions.title: Evidence gate before any online-intervention protocol may be proposed

A.summary: Conservative precondition for proposing—not deploying—an online controller.
requirements: at least 100 independently reference-labeled natural Candidate Stops not used to tune the frozen policy
95% upper confidence bound for false-accept rate no greater than 5%
false-continue point estimate no greater than 15%

B.summary: Moderate gate: 50 stops and false-accept upper bound no greater than 10%.
B.risk: Faster but materially weaker evidence for a safety-relevant intervention study.

C.summary: No numeric gate; proceed by qualitative judgment.

decisions.recommendation_reason: A treats false acceptance as the dominant safety risk and still only permits a later protocol proposal.
